methodological_notes.automated_hallucination_definition: Presence of specific ungrounded keywords (such as out-of-frame jeans/pants on headshots, or fabricated commercial game/movie franchises) verified as absent in ground truth manifest.
methodological_notes.human_evaluation_status: Human review template populated with live captions and marked PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW; no fabricated human ratings.
methodological_notes.limitations: Automated string-matching over known unsupported claims is an uncalibrated proxy; human visual inspection remains required for fine-grained semantic evaluation.
